mapper.select: SELECT VH.VIEW_ID , P.PRODUCT_ID , P.PRODUCT_NAME , P.PRICE , VH.VIEW_DT AS viewDt FROM VIEW_HISTORY VH INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON VH.TARGET_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE VH.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY VH.VIEW_DT DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO VIEW_HISTORY ( USER_ID, TARGET_ID, VIEW_DT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{productId}, NOW() )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM VIEW_HISTORY WHERE VIEW_ID = ( SELECT VIEW_ID FROM ( SELECT VIEW_ID FROM VIEW_HISTORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY VIEW_DT ASC LIMIT 1 ) T )
